notes: #42 metadata privacy: encrypted backups now seal all of their metadata (permissions, app label/icon, file list, sizes, SELinux contexts), stay portable, and still list instantly. A Show details button reveals the sealed metadata with the passphrase, without restoring. The same sealing covers the special, folder and /data/adb backups (and their file index). The flashless update check now fails gracefully when offline or already running.
